# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively support security updates for the following versions:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.1   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take security vulnerabilities seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please follow these steps:

### How to Report

1. **Do NOT** create a public GitHub issue
2. Email the security team or use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/TMHSDigital/Python-Playground/security/advisories/new)
3. Include the following information:
   - Description of the vulnerability
   - Steps to reproduce
   - Potential impact
   - Suggested fix (if any)

### What to Expect

- **Initial Response**: Within 48 hours
- **Status Update**: Within 7 days
- **Resolution**: Depends on severity and complexity

### Response Timeline

- **Critical**: Immediate attention, patch within 24-48 hours
- **High**: Response within 7 days, patch within 14 days
- **Medium**: Response within 14 days, patch within 30 days
- **Low**: Response within 30 days, patch in next release

### Disclosure Policy

- We will acknowledge receipt of your report
- We will keep you informed of the progress
- We will credit you in the security advisory (unless you prefer anonymity)
- We will coordinate public disclosure after a fix is available

## Security Best Practices

When contributing code:

- Validate all inputs
- Use parameterized queries (if applicable)
- Keep dependencies up to date
- Follow secure coding practices
- Review security implications of new features

## Supported Python Versions

We support Python 3.10 and above. Please ensure your security reports are reproducible on supported versions.

Thank you for helping keep Python Playground secure!
